mapper.sql: id, name, ip, domain, period, type, creation_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dailyreport (name, ip, domain, period, type, creation_date) VALUES (#{name}, #{ip}, #{domain}, #{period}, #{type}, #{creationDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE dailyreport SET name = #{name}, ip = #{ip}, domain = #{domain}, period = #{period}, type = #{type}, creation_date = #{creationDate} WHERE id = #{id}
